svg.desc: Animated seaside banner: the name p3achii bobbing in pixel letters, a sea otter floating on the waves hugging a peach, and a typewriter cycling through: hi, i'm p3achii ~ / i draw & make games / unity (mostly 3d) · c / c# / currently: live2d rigging / drawing for game dev ✦
